items.description: Phare du Cap Miné is a historic lighthouse located near Antsiranana, offering panoramic views of the bay and the surrounding coastal landscape.
Hôtel des Thermes in Antsirabe is an iconic colonial-era building famous for its grand architecture and historical significance as a spa destination.
Pont Kamoro is a notable historic bridge in Madagascar, recognized for its engineering design and role in connecting major regional transport routes.
Fort Flacourt in Taolagnaro (Fort-Dauphin) contains the ruins of a 17th-century French fortification, marking the first French attempt to establish a colony on the island.
The courthouse in Amboasary is a significant civic building, representing the administrative history and architectural style of the region.
Faravohitra Cathedral in Antananarivo is a prominent religious landmark known for its beautiful architecture and central location in the capital's historic district.
